scripts.build: bleep --directory .. link activity && cp ../.bleep/builds/normal/.bloop/activity/link-output/debug/js/main.js server.js && bleep --directory .. link activity-app && cp ../.bleep/builds/normal/.bloop/activity-app/link-output/debug/js/main.js app-core.cjs
scripts.reload: npm run build && bb plugin build . && bb plugin reload activity-recorder

bb.name: Activity recorder
bb.description: Records when you give each thread attention (speech, replies read aloud, typed messages, a focused pane) and serves per-thread activity intervals over RPC for other plugins.
